IDENT.title: A local industrial-agent middleware for resilient manufacturing execution systems under weak external connectivity

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: No formal definition; agent described as active participant that interprets requests, retrieves context, selects tools, generates actions.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: The agent is no longer only a conversational interface; it becomes an active participant in the production execution loop.

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: This paper develops a plant-side industrial-agent middleware for MES recovery

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: The agent middleware layer is implemented using C#/.NET and Microsoft semantic kernel.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: Qdrant stores vectorized SOPs, equipment manuals, historical recovery cases, and quality rules.

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: The embedding dimension is 768, using a locally deployed BAAI/bge-base-zh-v1.5 model.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: The model may generate a structured intent, select candidate tools, and propose a recovery plan, but the middleware validates every tool call before execution.

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: The implementation uses C#/.NET and Microsoft semantic kernel with Redis, InfluxDB, MySQL, local Qdrant, and Docker/K3s.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Vector store of SOPs, manuals, quality rules and historical recovery cases; MySQL audit logs; Redis volatile state; InfluxDB telemetry.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: Redis stores session state, task state, recovery markers, approval state, recent messages, tool-result caches, and RAGresult caches.

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: queries recent machine status from InfluxDB

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: The second stage reconstructs the context from Redis, MySQL, InfluxDB, and Qdrant.

C_MEMORY__memory_persists_across_episode.evidence_quote: After an SOP, quality rule, manual, or approved recovery case is released, the ingestion service computes a source identifier, version, checksum

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: The index is maintained by a version-aware incremental update path.

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: These data have short lifetimes and must be retrieved with low latency.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: These services are exposed to the agent through controlled tool schemas.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: Nginx gateway, C#/.NET and Microsoft semantic kernel middleware

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_analyzed.evidence_quote: Table 7 decomposes the mean end-to-end recovery latency.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_metric.value: latency per stage (ms), end-to-end mean and P95
D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_metric.evidence_quote: Total latency averaged 1.53 s and had a 95th percentile of 2.379 s.

D_COMMUNICATION__handles_comm_failure.evidence_quote: the middleware failed closed, performed no direct database write, and sent the task to resume-after-restoration or manual review.

E_LEARNING__learning_present.evidence_quote: The middleware is not formulated as a reinforcement-learning policy

E_LEARNING__learning_type.evidence_quote: The retrieved content is then combined with MES state and RAC-MES constraints.

E_LEARNING__explores_beyond_predefined_e.evidence_quote: It must invoke registered business functions so that authorization, validation, audit logging, and transaction rules remain consistent

E_LEARNING__uses_foundation_model.evidence_quote: Semantic Kernel is used to connect language-level reasoning with deterministic business execution.

E_LEARNING__foundation_model_role.evidence_quote: The model may generate a structured intent, select candidate tools, and propose a recovery plan

E_LEARNING__foundation_model_limitations.value: Prompt-level hallucination, stale/poisoned retrieval, tool-call failures (parameter missing, permission, state not allowed), adversarial prompts.
E_LEARNING__foundation_model_limitations.evidence_quote: This separation reduces the risk of prompt-level hallucination directly affecting MES data.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: The field evaluation was conducted with site permission on three Dongguan 3 C power-supply production lines.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: a consistency restoration rate of 0.954 (Wilson 95% interval: 0.932–0.969), a secondary damage rate of 0.082

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: The equipment data came from 47 equipment nodes and 156 data points.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: three computer, communication, and consumer-electronics power-supply lines

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: The agent is not allowed to directly modify database tables or generate raw structured query language (SQL).

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Single centralized LLM-based middleware agent for MES transaction recovery with deterministic permit contract and local RAG; no part/resource agents, no negotiation or capability discovery.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: The methodological contribution is a deterministic execution contract that combines current MES preconditions, role-checked user attribution, versioned local retrieval

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Provenance, approval, isolated updates, rollback for local vector DB claimed necessary.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: Provenance, approval, isolated updates, and rollback remain necessary.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: The middleware treats each business capability as a controlled tool.
